title: Examinations for license.
bodyText: Prior to the issuance of the license, each applicant for license as an adjuster or independent bill reviewer shall personally take and pass to the satisfaction of the commissioner an examination given by the commissioner as a test of the applicant's qualifications and competence.
crossReferences: Qualification for independent bill reviewer's license, see §431:9-243.

§431:9-206  Examinations for license.  Prior to the issuance of the license, each applicant for license as an adjuster or independent bill reviewer shall personally take and pass to the satisfaction of the commissioner an examination given by the commissioner as a test of the applicant's qualifications and competence. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2; am L 1993, c 205, §15; am L 1997, c 234, §2; am L 2000, c 288, §8; am L 2001, c 216, §9; am L 2021, c 111, §5]
